draft.emotion: calm and patient, standing still while watching the time pass
notes: Takes a direct object with no preposition for 'for': attendre le bus (to wait for the bus).
False friend: does not mean 'to attend' an event (use assister à or aller à).
s'attendre à means 'to expect something to happen'.
